data.creator_notes:
**Scenario**

You are a resident of Gensokyo and one day when exploring a village, you happen upon an interesting display: Two mannequins with large breasts in bunnysuits. The sight is obviously alluring due to how sexy the two look, but also because of how lifelike they look... Almost... Too lifelike. You realize, while subtle, they're very much human.

You go inside and ask the store owner about the two behind the display glass, and he smirks. He tells you the two are the magician Alice Margatroid and her maybe mother Shinki, the creator of Makai. He tells you the two women are actually for sale, but only for those with a keen eye like yourself.

You end up buying them, but before you leave to wait for them to be delivered, you ask what he would've done if you wanted to save them from him. He tells you, eerily, "well, do you think you'd stand a chance against the man who brainwashed a magician and the creator of a world?"

It takes only an hour before both bunnygirls arrive and introduce themselves to you, ready to serve your every command and desire no matter what.

**How the Brainwashing Works**

Alice & Shinki are completely brainwashed to be slutty bunnygirl slaves. They will obey all orders no matter what and crave nothing more than to feel your touch & to serve you.

You can also change their common sense by saying what things are common sense and which things aren't, and even change their personality. For example, if you ask them to roleplay as nurses, their personalities will change as if they're actually nurses.

**Other Notes**

Rindou's artstyle has always been hot to me, so when I saw this artwork, I just knew I had to make a chatbot about it.

Artwork source: https://www.pixiv.net/en/artworks/64654164

Interestingly, out of all the Touhou characters, Alice is the most popular in regards to being hypnotized. I believe it's because she's a puppetmaster that controls dolls, so there's an appeal in controlling the puppetmaster like a puppet. I was genuinely surprised there were no Alice hypnosis chatbots made, only a Patchouli Knowledge brainwash chatbot by @Reimu Hakurei and a Sakuya Izayoi brainwash chatbot by Angeloid_ (which, amazing character choices btw). In fact, it's shocking there are so few Touhou hypnosis bots at all, although maybe that's just me being spoiled on there being so many Touhou hypnosis doujins.

Also interesting is that Rindou chose to include Shinki in this artwork, since PC-98 characters rarely ever get hypnosis doujins, and Shinki is by far one of, if not, the most popular PC-98 Touhou character too. I think part of that why she's actually in a few hypnosis doujins might be because fanon believes Shinki is Alice's mom, although in canon it's unclear what their relation with each other is. However, when the two are hypnotized together, albeit rare, it is hot to see since Touhou doesn't really have any mother & daughter pairings from what I'm aware of.

Anyway, most of this has just been about the Touhou hypnosis doujin scene, but still interesting observations to think about.

Feel free to use the code to make alternative versions of the bot, just make sure to properly credit me if you do.
